installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## The UWorks plugin loads steamclient.so from its own ThirdParty directory.
UWORKS=$HOME/Citadel/Plugins/UWorks/Source/ThirdParty/Linux
mkdir -p $UWORKS
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so $UWORKS/steamclient.so

## The server rewrites its config on every boot, so both ini files live in one
## directory at the root and the engine reaches them through a symlink.
mkdir -p $HOME/Config
rm -rf $HOME/Citadel/Saved/Config/LinuxServer $HOME/Engine/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
mkdir -p $HOME/Citadel/Saved/Config $HOME/Engine/Saved/Config $HOME/Citadel/Saved/SaveGames
ln -sf ../../../Config $HOME/Citadel/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
ln -sf ../../../Config $HOME/Engine/Saved/Config/LinuxServer

if [[ ! -f $HOME/Config/Engine.ini ]]; then
cat <<EOT > $HOME/Config/Engine.ini
[URL]
Port=${SERVER_PORT}
EOT
fi

## WorldCreationSettings is seeded here and owned by the admin afterwards.
if [[ ! -f $HOME/Config/Game.ini ]]; then
cat <<EOT > $HOME/Config/Game.ini
[UWorks]
ConnectionPort=${SERVER_PORT}
QueryPort=${QUERY_PORT}

[/Script/Citadel.SocialManager]
Password=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}

[/Script/Citadel.CitadelGameInstance]
WorldCreationSettings=(ServerName="${SERVER_NAME}",Password="${SERVER_PASSWORD}",ServerType=${SERVER_TYPE},PlayerLimit=${MAX_PLAYERS},bPrivate=false,ExperienceMultiplier=1.000000,InventoryCapacityMultipler=1.000000,KnowledgePointEarnedMultiplier=1.000000,CharacterPointEarnedMultiplier=1.000000,bUnlimitedResources=false,PlayerDamageMultiplier=1.000000,ArmorMultiplier=1.000000,BaseManaRegen=1.000000,bInventoryWeightRestrictions=true,MagicFindMultiplier=1.000000,CraftingMagicFindChanceMultiplier=1.000000,FlyingCostMultiplier=1.000000,FlyingSpeedMultiplier=1.000000,ResourceCollectionMultiplier=1.000000,StructureDamageMultiplier=1.000000,bRespectNoBuildZones=true,MagicStructureManaRegenerationMultiplier=1.000000,MagicStructureManaConsumptionMultiplier=0.000000,bFreeBuildMode=false,TimeOfDayLock=Auto,NPCPopulationMultiplier=1.000000,StructureDecayMultiplier=2.000000,bThronesDecay=true)
EOT
fi

chmod +x $HOME/CitadelServer.sh

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name the server is listed under. Seeds WorldCreationSettings on install; after that the line in Config/Game.ini is yours to edit.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: If set, players must provide this password to join. Seeded into WorldCreationSettings on install.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: In-game admin password. Rewritten into Config/Game.ini on every boot.

variables.name: Server Type
variables.description: PVP or PVE. Seeded into WorldCreationSettings on install.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player cap. Seeded into WorldCreationSettings on install.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, used by the server browser. Needs its own allocation and cannot equal the game port.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app ID of the Citadel: Forged With Fire dedicated server. Do not change.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server through SteamCMD on every boot.

variables.name: Beta ID
variables.description: Beta branch of the steam app. Leave blank to install the normal branch.

variables.name: Beta Password
variables.description: Password for a beta branch, should one require it. Leave blank for no password.
